author: Kai Moreno
title: SOC 2 evidence pack intake (Trust Center)
content:
# Purpose
How Support and Customer Success collect a SOC 2 Type II evidence pack when a prospect or customer asks for Redwood's own controls. This is not a request to ship the customer's platform event stream to their cloud.

# When to use
Use this page when someone asks for our SOC 2 report, a Trust Center link, a pentest letter, or a controls matrix. Do not use this page when they want their own Redwood platform events copied to a bucket they own.

# Intake
Collect company name, who will receive the pack (email), whether they need the latest Type II report or only the bridge letter, and the NDA status. File the ticket as a sales-assist request.

# Priority and routing
These packs are priority P3. Assign Legal. Add the label trust-center. First response is 1bd. Do not page Engineering. Do not treat a deadline for their own auditor as a reason to raise this to P1.

# What we send
Legal sends the current SOC 2 Type II PDF, the latest bridge letter, and the public architecture whitepaper. We do not send raw control evidence, employee lists, or production configs.

# What we do not send
We do not enable a connector. We do not create a cloud sink. We do not copy customer-owned records. If they actually want their own event stream in their cloud, stop and open a different ticket using the customer-managed export SOP.

# Customer reply
Thanks for asking for our SOC 2 pack. Legal will send the Trust Center link after NDA. If you instead need your own Redwood records in your cloud, say so and we will open a separate request.

# Related
Trust Center access. NDA process. This page does not replace the customer-managed export SOP.
